summary_en: City Index Fifth extended the public tender offer period for Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation units to November 30, 2026, from the originally planned November 10, providing unitholders additional time to decide on the 125,000 yen per unit offer as a competing proposal from a private equity fund emerged.
title_en: Notice of Partial Amendment to the Notice Regarding the Opinion of Support and Neutrality Regarding the Public Tender Offer for Investment Units in Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (Code: 2972) by City Index Fifth
translation_en_brief:
City Index Fifth, the tender offeror for the proposed delisting of Sankei Real Estate Investment Corporation (Code: 2972), announced on November 9, 2026, that it has extended the public tender offer period to November 30, 2026 (43 business days), from the originally scheduled closing date of November 10, 2026 (30 business days). The offer price remains fixed at 125,000 yen per unit, with a minimum purchase threshold of 118,732 units.

The extension was decided to provide unitholders with additional time to decide following the emergence of a competing proposal. On November 5, 2026, the REIT disclosed receipt of a non-binding letter of intent regarding a privatization proposal from a private equity fund. The tender offeror stated it decided to extend the offer period to comprehensively account for application status and outlook, as well as the possibility that a concrete counter-proposal might be made regarding the alternative proposal.

The REIT stated that its opinion regarding the public tender offer, as disclosed on September 25, 2026, remains unchanged as of November 9, 2026. The offeror plans to complete the squeeze-out procedure by February 28, 2027 (the fiscal year-end date for the fiscal period ending February 2027), with no change to this completion timeline despite the extended tender offer period.
